heading: INT. NIGHT COURT - ARRAIGNMENT ROOM - 1 A.M.

units.text: INT. NIGHT COURT - ARRAIGNMENT ROOM - 1 A.M.
A drab room under buzzing fluorescents.
A raised bench, a witness stand with a chipped rail, a row of empty gallery seats.
A clock stuck at ten past three.
JUDGE OCTAVIA ROSENBLATT-ODUYA, sixties, sits at the bench with a thermos.
At the defense table, PUBLIC DEFENDER LEON FAIRWEATHER, thirties, shuffles papers that do not need shuffling.
At the prosecution table, ASSISTANT DA MERCEDES IBARRA-NOLAN, forties, taps a pen.
In the dock stands a MAN in a green hospital gown, barefoot, tall, hair sticking up.
We're on the record. Docket 4471. State versus...
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: She squints at her papers.
John Doe? Again?
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: Your Honor, my client has declined to give his name.
units.name: LEON

units.text: It's not that I decline. I'm not certain.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Mr. Doe, do you understand the charge?
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: Trespassing at the aquarium.
units.name: MAN

units.text: After hours. In the shark tank.
units.name: MERCEDES

units.text: It was a very peaceful tank.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Please don't talk.
units.name: LEON

units.text: The State will note he also had a crowbar and a wetsuit.
units.name: MERCEDES

units.text: It was a diving lesson.
units.name: LEON

units.text: At two in the morning.
units.name: MERCEDES

units.text: I was looking for someone.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Looking for whom?
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: A woman. Long hair. She said her name was Marisol and that she lived in the tank.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Leon closes his eyes.
Mercedes sets down her pen.
The judge puts a hand over her mouth to cover a smile.
Mr. Doe...
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: It's not Doe. I remember now. It's Corwin.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Corwin?
units.name: LEON

units.text: Corwin Albright-Santos. I'm a marine biologist.
units.name: CORWIN

units.text: Your Honor, he's been in the system four times this year.
units.name: MERCEDES

units.text: Five.
units.name: CORWIN

units.text: Corwin, please.
units.name: LEON

units.text: Mr. Albright-Santos, I'm going to release you on your own recognizance. On one condition.
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: Anything.
units.name: CORWIN

units.text: Stay out of the tank.
units.name: JUDGE ROSENBLATT-ODUYA

units.text: I'll try.
units.name: CORWIN

units.text: She bangs the gavel.
The clock still reads ten past three.
